title: Denial of Lift Upgrading due to Funding Limit
what_it_is: Denial of Lift Upgrading due to Funding Limit

sections.label: Lift upgrading programme progress
sections.summary: Over 5,300 HDB blocks lacked full lift access; most now benefit from LUP, leaving about 150 blocks without solutions.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: At the start of the programme, there were more than 5,300 Housing and Development Board (HDB) blocks without 100% lift access.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: LUP was initially found to be unfeasible for more than 1,000 of these blocks due to cost or technical constraints.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Through these efforts, the vast majority of the 5,300 blocks have since been able to benefit from LUP and there remain only about 150 blocks where HDB has not found any solutions to overcome existing constraints.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: About 70% of these 150 blocks are not eligible for lift upgrading due to cost considerations.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In total, less than 1% of sold flats do not have direct lift access.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: In addition, asking residents to co-share part of the amount beyond the cost cap may cause undue financial hardship to residents.

sections.label: Cost of ineligible blocks
sections.summary: For blocks not eligible due to cost, upgrading costs are well in excess of $100,000 per unit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Part of it is technical, part of it is just the way in which the block is designed in relation to the land surrounding it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But for those blocks that are not eligible because of cost considerations, they are well in excess of $100,000 per unit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The nature of these remaining number of blocks, the cost would be way in excess of $100,000.
